resume_suggestions: Add a brief description of a personal project utilizing AWS to demonstrate cloud computing experience and adaptability.
Highlight a team project where React and Java were used together to showcase full-stack development skills and teamwork.
Include a specific example of effective communication in a previous role, such as 'presented project updates to a team of 10 stakeholders' to address the communication gap.
Emphasize problem-solving skills by describing a complex Java or SQL problem overcome, with a measurable outcome, such as 'reduced bug resolution time by 30%'.
Create a new section for 'Soft Skills' and list adaptability, communication, and teamwork to directly address the missing skills from the job description.
Add a Spring Boot certification or course completion to the Education or Certifications section to demonstrate willingness to learn new technologies.
Describe a collaborative project where Git was used for version control, highlighting the ability to work effectively in a team environment and utilize problem-solving skills.
Quantify the impact of a project that involved Java, SQL, and React, such as 'increased application performance by 25% through optimization and problem-solving'.
